sources.name: BusElche / Avanza official route directory for Lines E and J
Current AliBus ordered E and J stop pages with municipal stop codes and map coordinates
Current Moovit E and J circular route sequence cross-check
Accepted A/B/C and D/F/H scenarios used for exact shared StopNode and StopPlace reuse

transformations.description: Combines each line's ordered outbound and return lists into one complete cycle. Repeated direction handoff and cycle-boundary occurrences are removed, and closesLoop=true adds the final closing edge once.
Uses the municipal stop code as the stable elche-stop and elche-place suffix. Accepted identities from earlier Elche scenarios are copied exactly.
Creates one strict parser-compatible StopPlace for every new directional StopNode. No proximity-only physical merges are made.
Writes established scenario assets, computes asset SHA-256 values and aggregate contentHash, and registers the scenario.

warnings: Runtime StopNode sourceReferences remain empty for new nodes because that field accepts only genuine OpenStreetMap platform or stop_position components. Municipal codes and AliBus coordinates remain build provenance.
Accepted StopNode and StopPlace objects reused from A/B/C and D/F/H retain their exact previous bytes and coordinates.
E and J are explicit circular patterns. The first StopNode is not repeated at the end; closesLoop=true adds the closing edge exactly once.
Physical StopPlace creation does not create route edges, reverse patterns, or cross-pattern itinerary edges.
The AliBus current J cycle contains both stops 117 and 205 on the central-to-Raval leg. The cycle is preserved as published rather than compressed to the shorter Moovit list.
